title: Soak in a private bath at Ten Thousand Waves

location.label: Ten Thousand Waves, Santa Fe, New Mexico

description: Just outside Santa Fe, Ten Thousand Waves sets its private hot tubs among trees and mountain air. Reserve a bath, move between hot water and a cool pause, then consider a meal or treatment if you want to linger. The Japanese-inspired setting makes the transition from the city’s streets to quiet feel almost immediate.
teaser: Warm up in a secluded bath in the Santa Fe hills.
goodToKnow: Reserve private baths and dining; check hot-water suitability and winter access.
whyItMightDelightYou: It is the kind of pause that leaves room for conversation, silence, or simply watching the steam.
